text: GSE293381 is a Mus musculus single-cell multiome ATAC plus gene expression series of WIF1-induced normal-tension glaucoma.
The experiment includes control, 2-week WIF1 and 4-week WIF1 mouse retina groups; six mouse eyes were used for single-nucleus multiome profiling, two eyes per condition.
GEO lists six GEX/ATAC sample entries: GSM8881191 through GSM8881196. These are assay records and must not be treated as six independent biological time trajectories.
GSE293381 offers gzipped sparse matrix, features and barcodes for Ctrl, WIF1-2w and WIF1-4w. The matrices are large; none is bundled in this package.

The study additionally reports 10x Visium spatial transcriptomics for Ctrl, WIF1-2w and WIF1-4w retina; verify access to matching Visium matrices and coordinates before building a spatial neighbor graph.
snATAC-seq measures chromatin accessibility, not CpG DNA methylation. No measured DNAm tensor should be inferred from ATAC without a separate assay.
Cross-sectional 0, 2 and 4 week mouse groups are not repeated observations of the same tracked cell; temporal transitions must be labeled population-level estimates.
